content.short: Yumi Finance builds on-chain credit products, including buy now, pay later, on stablecoin rails.
content.description: Yumi Labs builds financial systems for assets banks cannot underwrite, starting with on-chain buy now, pay later and other credit products running on stablecoin rails. It is backed by founders from projects such as ether.fi and Resolv. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Yumi Finance.
content.meta: Yumi Finance builds on-chain credit and BNPL products on stablecoin rails, listed on Stable.
